fila.Title: Efect of Perception of Organizational Support on Organizational Citizenship Behaviour: The Mediating Role of Employee Happiness
fila.Author: Shiwani Singh; Taruna; Jyoti Singh Bharti
fila.Tipo de felicidad real: Otro: felicidad del empleado (constructo multifacético, ítems no reportados)
fila.Correlacion o Beta felicidad 1 - JP: Correlación 0.463 (Tabla 4, p. 9 del PDF) | Beta .542 (Tabla 8, p. 12 del PDF)
fila.Definition Happiness: Paráfrasis: la felicidad es una noción multifacética que abarca bienestar psicológico, emociones positivas y satisfacción general con el trabajo y la vida (Diener, 2000; Fisher, 2010; Grant et al., 2007; p. 3 del PDF).
fila.Definition Performance: Paráfrasis: la OCB es una conducta individual discrecional, no reconocida directa o explícitamente por el sistema formal de recompensas, que en conjunto promueve el funcionamiento eficaz de la organización (Organ, 1988; p. 3 del PDF).
fila.Aim of study: Examinar la relación entre la percepción de apoyo organizacional y la conducta de ciudadanía organizacional, y el efecto de la felicidad del empleado como variable mediadora de esa relación.
fila.Exclusion criteria: Cuestionarios no válidos (no diligenciados completamente): de 247 respuestas recibidas se analizaron 219.
fila.Validez de las escalas: AFC (CB-SEM, AMOS): POS: AVE = 0.783; CR = 0.966. Felicidad (EH): AVE = .737; CR = .943. OCB: AVE = .801; CR = .965. Modelo: χ2/df = 2.32; SRMR = .057; RMSEA = .08; CFI = .95; TLI = .94.
fila.Analysis method (detalle):
Análisis factorial confirmatorio
Modelo de ecuaciones estructurales (SEM) con AMOS 26
Análisis de mediación de Baron y Kenny
Bootstrapping con 5000 remuestreos
fila.Conclusion: Los autores concluyen que la percepción de apoyo organizacional es clave para promover la felicidad del empleado, que a su vez conduce a más conductas de ciudadanía organizacional. La felicidad media parcialmente la relación entre el apoyo percibido y la OCB, y los empleados felices tienden a mostrar más comportamientos extra-rol.

Title.cita_textual: Perception of Organizational Support on Organizational Citizenship Behaviour: The Mediating Role of Employee Happiness

Año.ubicacion: Pie de la primera página, derechos

Población.cita_textual: small and medium retail sector employees working in Gorakhpur City

Validez CFA.cita_textual: confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) was applied to verify the measurement scale’s validity and reliability

CFA.cita_textual: confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) was applied to verify the measurement scale’s validity and reliability

Analysis method (principal).cita_textual: the direct and mediation hypotheses were tested using the SEM with AMOS 26

Study design.cita_textual: The data was obtained from 219 retail sector employees through the survey questionnaire.

Teoría 1.cita_textual: The current study examines POS, EH and OCB all within the framework of social exchange theory (SET).
According to (Blau, 1964) positive behaviour from others are more likely to be reciprocated by employees.

Definition Happiness.cita_textual: Happiness is a multifaceted notion that encompasses psychological well-being, positive emotions, and overall satisfaction with work and life

Definition Performance.cita_textual: individual behavior that is discretionary, not directly or explicitly recognized by the formal reward system

Direccionalidad de la relación.cita_textual: the OCB is significantly impacted by the EH (Beta = 0.542, p < 0.01)

Aim of study.cita_textual: employee happiness (EH) as a mediating variable on this relationship

Exclusion criteria.cita_textual: A total of 247 responses were received out of which 219 were found to be valid (duly filled)

Tipo de muestreo.cita_textual: A convenience sampling method was adopted to distribute 350 survey forms to employees

Analysis method (detalle).cita_textual: confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) was applied to verify the measurement scale’s validity and reliability
Four steps mediation process suggested by Baron and Kenny was utilized

Conclusion.cita_textual: our study supports the hypothesis that POS is crucial in promoting EH at work, which in turn causes OCB.
Happy employees are more inclined to indulge in extra-role performance.
